text:
Priya (People Ops): quick help — candidate Aisha (onsite) has a panel at 2pm PT but one panelist just dropped. can someone cover 2:00–2:30? also need a debrief lead and a reminder about rubric weighting for system design vs implementation.
Samir: I can cover the slot if needed. plugging 2–2:30 into my calendar now.
Alex Chen: I can take debrief lead. quick q — for this role are we using the 40/60 split (system design 40%, implementation 60%) or the newer 50/50?
Priya (People Ops): follow the hiring guide — 40/60 for IC3 backend roles. flag if you think candidate requires different weighting.
Maya Patel: I'll update the invite and add the backup panelist (Samir). also giving Alex debrief lead permissions on the eval form.
calendar-bot: Created updated invite: "Panel — Aisha" with attendees Priya, Alex Chen, Samir, Jordan R., Maya Patel. Room: 5B-3 (access: front desk + QR).
Jordan R.: quick rubric note — please use the short anchor prompts in the eval: "clarity of design", "tradeoffs", "correctness of code". We should call out the implementation rubric for the take-home vs live coding.
Alex Chen: got it. will capture anchors during interview. Samir — can you grab screenshots of any whiteboard notes for the debrief?
Samir: yup, will take photos and drop them in the candidate folder after.
Priya (People Ops): thanks all. last ask — proctor access: if you can't get into room, ping me and I'll call building security.
Maya Patel: updated calendar description with eval link and debrief checklist:
```
DEBRIEF FORM: https://redwood.app/evals/new?cand=Aisha
CHECKLIST: score each anchor, add 1–2 sentence notes, attach whiteboard photo
```
Priya (People Ops): reminder: submit debrief within 24h so hiring committee can triage. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: will submit within 2h after interview.
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled 15 minutes before panel.
